subject: Request: short-term sandbox credit reclaim & usage guardrail proposal
messages:
From: Tiara Morgan <tiara.morgan@opsly.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Lin <jake.lin@opsly.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial sandbox expired — short extension possible?

Hi Monica,

We ran into an unexpected blocker this morning: our onboarding automation started a bunch of heavy-generation tests, and the sandbox credits on our account expired overnight. We're in the middle of a POC evaluation and need another 7 days to finish load testing before the exec review next Friday.

Is there any way Redwood can grant a one-time short extension or emergency top-up so we can complete the tests? Happy to sign a quick addendum or confirm usage bounds. We're evaluating cost/latency now and want to present final numbers.

Thanks — appreciate any help.

—Tiara
Tiara Morgan
Head of Platform, Opsly
tiara.morgan@opsly.io
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: opsly-usage-log-202704.csv (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tiara Morgan <tiara.morgan@opsly.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial sandbox expired — short extension possible?

Hi Tiara — thanks for the note and the usage log.

Short answer: yes, we can do a one-time emergency top-up for POCs under a few guardrails. Before I push this through, can you confirm two things for me:

1) A target token/credit amount that will cover your remaining tests (ballpark is fine).
2) That the environment is only for evaluation (no production traffic) and you agree to a 7-day expiry on any top-up we grant.

If you confirm, I'll route an approval to our sales ops and CS leads and send a brief addendum (DocuSign) to sign. We typically limit these to a single short extension or a capped credit top-up to avoid open-ended liabilities.

Cc'ing Ben (AE) and Neha (Sales Ops) to keep them in the loop.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial sandbox expired — short extension possible? (approval request)

Monica — quick flag on internal approvals. Opsly is a mid-market POC; deal pipeline shows healthy intent but not closed yet. I'm comfortable with a one-week cap if Sales Ops confirms no other outstanding issues.

Suggested guardrails for Opsly:
- One-time 100k token top-up (equivalent to our standard POC refresh)
- Expires 7 days after issuance
- Monitoring: enable billing alerts and export usage to the Opsly S3 they shared (we already have upload configured)
- Require signed addendum (DocuSign) acknowledging evaluation use only

Neha — can you confirm whether we need Finance approval for a 100k token credit on OP SLY-4821, or if Sales Ops can auto-approve? If finance needs visibility, I can loop them.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial sandbox expired — short extension possible? (approval request)

Thanks Ben — Sales Ops confirmed. For a one-time emergency top-up under 150k tokens we can approve without Finance sign-off, provided:

- Customer signs a one-page addendum with expiry and usage restrictions;
- CS checks security/compliance checkbox (they provided the SRD);
- We document the approval in HubSpot and attach the signed addendum.

Monica — I'll prepare the addendum and upload it to DocuSign. Attaching the security questionnaire Opsly provided; CS says nothing outstanding.

Neha Kapoor
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: opsly_srd_security_questionnaire.pdf (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tiara Morgan <tiara.morgan@opsly.io>, Jake Lin <jake.lin@opsly.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: One-time sandbox credit offer for Opsly (7 days)

Hi Tiara / Jake — thanks for the fast turnaround on the usage log and the SRD. Good news: Redwood can provide a one-time 100k token credit to restore your sandbox so you can finish load testing.

Key terms: 
- Amount: 100,000 tokens (one-time top-up)
- Expiry: 7 calendar days from issuance (we will set expiry on 2027-04-29 23:59 PDT)
- Scope: evaluation/sandbox use only — no production traffic permitted during this window
- Monitoring: we will enable billing alerts at 70% consumption and share a usage export daily
- Authorization: sign the attached one-page addendum via DocuSign (link below).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/opsly-credit-topup
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 (OPSLY-4821)

If that sounds good, please sign the addendum and I'll request issuance once we have the signed DocuSign and Jake confirms the sandbox deployment ID to credit. We'll also attach the approval to the deal record for audit.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments included: one-time-credit-approval.docx (stub)
